name: Arkansas

agency.name: Arkansas Department of Finance and Administration, Office of Motor Vehicle

taxAgency.name: Arkansas Department of Finance and Administration

gaps: Every vehicle is assessed by the county assessor and pays a yearly county personal property tax at the local millage; no statewide table exists, so the line has no amount.
Cities lying in several counties are listed with the first county named by DFA; the county part of the rate may differ at your address (DFA Local Tax Lookup).
DFA states a 7% state rate for Texarkana residents without saying how it combines with the used-vehicle reduced rate; the engine applies 7% only where the full rate applies.
Whether the dealer service and handling fee is part of the taxable price was not found on a DFA page; the engine leaves it out of the taxed amount.
The credit for a vehicle sold privately within 60 days of the purchase is not modeled; enter it as a trade-in for the state part only if it applies.
Lien filing ($0.50) and the extra $1 postage for plates mailed from Little Rock are not included.

summary.docFeeNote: Dealer service and handling fee capped at $129 by Motor Vehicle Commission Rule 8 and charged uniformly to all retail customers.
summary.inspectionWhere: No safety or emissions inspection is among the documents DFA requires to register a car.

singular: New cars pay the full 6.5% state sales tax, while used vehicles under $4,000 pay no sales tax and those from $4,000 to $9,999 pay a reduced 3.5% state rate [dfa-faq].
The $4,000 and $10,000 thresholds are read on the sales price before any trade-in is deducted [act-1013].
Local tax is not reduced on a used vehicle of $4,000 to $9,999: only the state rate drops [dfa-changes].
Each city or county tax is capped at $25 for each 1% of rate, which limits local tax to the first $2,500 of the price [dfa-registration].
A trade-in reduces the taxed amount: tax is computed on the consideration paid less the trade-in credit [dfa-trade-in].
Registration depends on weight: $17 up to 3,000 lb, $25 from 3,001 to 4,500 lb and $30 above, plus a $2.50 decal and 50 cents of postage [dfa-fee-schedule].
Electric cars pay an extra $200 a year, plug-in hybrids $100 and other hybrids $50 [act-376].
To register, the owner must show the county assessment of the vehicle and proof that last year’s personal property taxes are paid [dfa-assessment].
Dealers may charge a service and handling fee of no more than $129, the same for every retail customer [doc-fee].

dfa-registration.name: Arkansas DFA, Vehicle Tag Renewal and registration requirements
dfa-registration.quote: The state sales and use tax rate is 6.5%, 7% for Texarkana residents, of the taxable price of motor vehicles ... with a gross purchase price of $4000.00 or greater. ... Each local tax will not exceed $25.00 for each 1% of tax due.

dfa-trade-in.name: Arkansas DFA, Vehicle Tag Renewal: Credit for Trade-In
dfa-trade-in.quote: If the invoice or bill of sale reflects a credit given for a trade-in, tax is computed on the difference of the total consideration paid less the trade-in credit.

dfa-assessment.name: Arkansas DFA, registration requirements (assessment and personal property tax)
dfa-assessment.quote: Proof from your county assessor showing that the vehicle has been assessed or listed for assessment for the current year. Proof that personal property taxes due by the previous October 15th have been paid.

dfa-changes.name: Arkansas DFA, Recent Changes in the Law (Act 1013 of 2021)
dfa-changes.quote: If the total price for the sale of a used motor vehicle, trailer or semitrailer is at least ($4,000) but less than ($10,000), the gross price of the vehicle will be taxed at the reduced state tax rate of (3.5%). Local tax will not be subject to the reduced state tax rate.

act-1013.name: Arkansas Act 1013 of 2021 (Ark. Code § 26-52-324)
act-1013.quote: the sales price for the used motor vehicle, trailer, or semitrailer shall not be reduced by: (1) The value of a motor vehicle, trailer or semitrailer traded in as part payment

act-376.quote: (1) Two hundred dollars ($200) for each electric vehicle ... Fifty dollars ($50.00) for each hybrid ... (3) One hundred dollars ($100) for each plug-in hybrid electric

doc-fee.name: Arkansas Motor Vehicle Commission, Rule 8, Dealer Service and Handling Fees
doc-fee.quote: The amount that an Arkansas dealer may charge for Dealer Service and Handling Fees, allowed by A.C.A. §23-112-317(d) is not to exceed $129.00. The fee, if charged, must be charged uniformly to all retail customers.

dfa-faq.name: Arkansas DFA, DSMV FAQs
dfa-faq.quote: What is the sales tax rate for a motor vehicle? New Vehicle – 6.5% Used Vehicle – $4,000 through $9,999 will be 3.5% Used Vehicle – $3,999 and below no sales tax due
